intro: The Quarry's Smith is an arrangement offered by Frast Dokner, a working craftsman stationed at a quarry camp. Stranded without an expected supply delivery, the smith turns to willing travelers to gather raw metal and sturdy leather for essential camp repairs. In exchange for the needed materials, Dokner shares practical smithing techniques with aspiring metalworkers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you're looking to learn the blacksmith's trade? Maybe we can help each other.
The supply shipment's late, and I need materials for some repairs around the camp. If you get me what I need, I'll teach you some of my techniques. Sound fair?
